request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; specific milestones range from 6 to 52 weeks, with architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node upgrades, hard fork readiness, and compatible releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Ecosystem expansion including Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp connector, and Japanese localisation
User support for Daedalus users, including Japanese-language support
Maintenance of Windows, macOS x86_64, macOS aarch64, and Linux builds
Independent financial audit and Intersect-administered milestone-based disbursement
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc., with Intersect serving as administrator and milestone verifier
request.what: Fund Daedalus Wallet maintenance and improvements for 2026-2027 as a time and materials engagement delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the proposer asserting the true count is higher.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and has shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization.

The scope includes maintaining Daedalus compatibility with cardano-node and cardano-wallet releases, hard forks, Leios, Peras, Nested Transactions, platform dependencies, and security patches throughout the contract year.

The proposal commits to a compatible stable Daedalus release at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork and states release-timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.

The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA total, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for maintenance and improvements, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The proposer states that unspent labor, hardware, and audit budget will be returned to the treasury.
Intersect will administer funds, verify milestones, disburse monthly against verified work, and hold withdrawn funds in a dedicated auditable account before disbursement to Se7en Labs.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Se7en Labs states it has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for a 2026-2027 public-good maintenance and improvement program for Daedalus, administered by Intersect with milestone-based disbursement and focused on protocol compatibility, releases, platform support, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, user support, and architecture assessment.
